steps.q: Walk me through your estate: what runs on it, how many hosts and VMs, how much storage, how big is the team?
steps.label: estate walkthrough

steps.q: What did the reseller say that made you agree to the meeting?
steps.label: her pain

steps.q: You mentioned [pain]. What does that affect over the next 6 to 12 months?
steps.label: what it affects

steps.q: What's driving [pain] to be a priority?
steps.label: why it's a problem

steps.q: Is this the thing to focus on, or will something overpower it?
steps.label: focus check

steps.q: Roughly how much has it gone up by? 10%, 50%, or more? Can you put a monetary value on it?
steps.label: numbers

steps.q: Is that a yearly cost or a one-off purchase?
steps.label: quote type

steps.q: When is the deadline for this?
steps.label: deadline

steps.q: And when is the renewal date?
steps.label: renewal date

steps.q: What happens if nothing changes by [her date]?
steps.label: doing nothing

steps.q: Why do you think this is going to hit you so hard?
steps.label: cause

steps.q: What else is driving this to matter right now?
steps.label: other drivers

steps.q: What ripple effect is this having on other people? Who else feels this, and why is it a concern to them?
steps.label: ripple effect

steps.q: How does this affect you personally?
steps.label: personal stake

steps.q: Who else needs to sign off on this? What would they need to see?
steps.label: sign-off

steps.q: Where would the money for this come from? Is it set aside, or does it need requesting?
steps.label: budget

steps.q: What do you think you need to solve [pain]?
steps.followup: What do you need to happen before [her date]?
steps.label: needs

steps.q: Which of those matters most to you?
steps.label: top need

steps.q: Why does that matter to you personally?
steps.label: need reason
